items.q: Herbie Cowan was the drummer but it was his band.

ctx.x: Yeah. They had dancers. Well, the band with me was Herbie Cowan. Herbie Cowan was the drummer but it was his band. And we did -- oh, we did so well. That was on the ETO, the ETO group.
